blurb.en: Verify, format, and keep the agent rules in sync before you commit or merge.

blurb.en: Run the Docker Compose stack, prepare local secrets, regenerate protobuf stubs.

blurb.en: Environment checks, git hooks, the scripts' own tests, and cache cleanup.
blurb.ru: Проверка окружения, git-хуки, тесты самих скриптов и очистка кэшей.
